result.title: A Switching Mechanism for Selecting Environment-Adaptive Personalized Gains in Hearing Aids
result.summary: Personalized amplification gains for hearing aids have been shown to be preferred over prescriptive gains. Since the preferred settings can vary depending on the background audio environment, this paper presents a switching mechanism or system that automatically selects personalized gains for a current background audio environment. To prevent foreground speech from interfering with background environment analysis, a one-class voice activity detector is designed to identify speech activity from speech mixed with noise. A consistency check is conducted to enable distinguishing foreground speech from background speech, preserving babble as a background environment of interest because hearing aid users often struggle to understand speech in background babble. Sound segments without foreground speech are then analyzed by an online discovery method combining Bayesian change-point detection with a memory of previously encountered environments. This discovery method detects changes, recognizes returning environments, and discovers new ones without a predefined number of environments. Experimental results show that three-seed mean macro-averaged F1 scores of 85.53%-91.98% across eight speech/background-corpus pairs covering 36 background noise types were achieved. Furthermore, the discovery method achieved adjusted Rand indices of 0.91 and 0.96 on two families of test streams. In the same-recording-return condition of audio streams combining speech with four background audio environments often encountered by hearing aid users, the switching mechanism selected the correct personalized gain profile after 105 environment changes, recalled the stored gain profile at every return, and made no switches to an incorrect gain profile.

AI.brief_summary: 提出助听器的个性化增益切换机制：用单类语音活动检测与一致性检查区分前景语音和背景声，再以贝叶斯变点检测结合历史环境记忆在线识别、复用和发现背景声环境，从而自动选择对应增益。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「变点检测＋环境记忆」的在线状态识别与切换、前景/背景证据分离，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的选择与切换、视觉证据筛选及状态缓存复用提供概念线索，但领域相距较远，需较多核查。
